scope: Actual React board, GameStore and canonical match authority. Ambiguity uses an explicitly controlled UI fixture. No public deployment.

scenarios.name: Real King lifts, activates only its legal destinations and previews without changing game state
King release sends one existing action intent to real authority and updates hand, pending plays and log
Illegal Enduring Row drop stays quiet and cannot submit
Ambiguous release preserves preview and awaits an explicit keyboard choice
Confirm preference requires an explicit legal action confirmation and persists
Click below threshold retains card selection; Quick Play OFF leaves normal legal actions usable
Revision change, game ending, active-seat change, pointercancel, capture loss, blur and resize cancel without submission
Chooser invalidation and Escape never leave a stranded preview
Authority rejection restores presentation and surfaces the existing error
Narrow layout and transformed board use viewport geometry; reduced motion cancels cleanly
